purpose: Local identity and access model for learning RBAC, least privilege and privileged access concepts.

users.name: Sarah Frey
users.notes: Needs read access for investigations, but should not manage Azure resources.

users.name: Max Keller
users.notes: Needs limited resource management permissions in a specific lab scope.

users.name: Jannik Richter
users.notes: Uses admin access only in the lab scope. High privilege should be monitored.

groups.name: Cloud Engineers
groups.purpose: Manage selected cloud resources in controlled scopes.

roleAssignments.reason: Sarah needs to investigate alerts and security posture.
Max needs to manage lab resources, but not the whole subscription.
Jannik owns the local learning lab and manages lab-level access.

securityRules: No standard user should receive permanent Owner permissions.
Privileged access should be limited to the smallest possible scope.
Role assignments should be reviewed regularly.
Suspicious role assignments should be investigated through audit logs.
Admin accounts should use MFA and should be monitored closely.

detectionIdeas.name: Suspicious Role Assignment
detectionIdeas.reason: Role assignments can indicate privilege escalation or persistence.

detectionIdeas.name: Risky Admin Sign-in
detectionIdeas.reason: Successful sign-ins from admin-like accounts should be reviewed carefully.
